Other requirements
  • No direct first-year entry to the B.S. in Commerce: students apply to McIntire in the spring of their first year at UVA and, if accepted, start in their second year
  • Prerequisites to apply: COMM 1800 Foundations of Commerce, ECON 2010 Principles of Microeconomics, and the First Writing Requirement (taken at UVA)
  • Applicants with college credit from high school still complete at least one academic year at UVA first

This covers McIntire’s internal application only. UVA’s first-year application requirements (essays, supplements) could not be checked because admission.virginia.edu returned 403 (Cloudflare bot challenge) on 2026-10-19.
